source.snippet: I Interviewed 50 Freelancers About Late Payments. Almost Everyone Was Solving the Wrong Problem. If... [article based on 50 freelancer interviews about late payment pain, arguing the root cause is misdiagnosed]

problem_statement: Freelancers across disciplines lose significant income to late or non-payment from clients, and existing invoicing and follow-up tools fail to address the real root cause — lack of payment commitment mechanisms upfront and at contract stage.
target_segment: Independent freelancers and small agencies in web development, design, and creative services billing clients on net terms
notes: Author interviewed 50 freelancers — breadth of signal is above average for a single source. Late payment is a documented recurring cost (lost revenue, cash flow gaps). Freelancers actively pay for invoicing tools (Wave, HoneyBook, Bonsai, FreshBooks) indicating willingness to pay. The framing 'wrong problem' suggests an underserved angle: upfront payment commitment or deposit enforcement tooling rather than post-invoice chasing.
